# theme-ga provenance

## Source

- Upstream name: `kitty-theme-ga.py`
- Original upstream: a personal dotfiles repository; its URL and exact revision were not retained.
- Earliest recoverable repository copy: [`ariel-ps/herdr-kit`](https://github.com/ariel-ps/herdr-kit), commit `bb1d56a500865fe7993a3672ba75561bcb40db76`.
- Imported into Herdr Colors in commit `5aa43fb434dfe431799afebd5022e1254c370b66`.
- Imported file SHA-256: `7d6397fa912d2a52027b441675702a8356a6a26f80c642a41ed547285531096a`.

## License

The original source carried no license header, and no component-specific upstream license record was retained. There is therefore no independently verifiable upstream license file to cite. The repository-level [MIT License](../../LICENSE) covers original Herdr Colors project code but does not resolve this missing historical provenance.

## Local modifications

The copy imported into Herdr Colors matched the recoverable `herdr-kit` copy byte for byte. This migration only moved it from `vendor/theme-ga.py` to `vendor/theme-ga/theme-ga.py`; no source changes were made.
